title: Newmark Arranges $20.75 Million Sale of Century Springs in Sandy Springs, Georgia
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the $20.75 million sale of Century Springs Office Park, a 192,247-square-foot, two-building infill office…
body_markdown:
**September 10, 2026 9:00 AM**
Newmark announces the Company has arranged the $20.75 million sale of Century Springs Office Park, a 192,247-square-foot, two-building infill office property in the Central Perimeter submarket in the heart of Sandy Springs, Georgia.


”Century Springs demonstrates the durability of the neighborhood office model,” said O’Meara. “The property has a diverse base of local businesses, medical tenants and service firms that are highly committed to the location, supported by a walkable setting, proximity to executive housing, and a beautiful setting. With an increasing portion of office inventory in the Atlanta’s Central Perimeter submarket increasingly being removed for redevelopment, the fundamentals for well-located in-fill assets like Century Springs continue to strengthen.”
[Capital Markets](https://www.nmrk.com/services/investor-solutions/capital-markets) Vice Chairmen[Jay O’Meara](https://www.nmrk.com/people/jay-omeara) and[Justin Parsonnet](https://www.nmrk.com/people/justin-parsonnet) and Senior Managing Director[Ryan Reethof](https://www.nmrk.com/people/ryan-reethof) represented the seller, The Ardent Companies (Ardent), in the transaction. A partnership between OA Development and Buligo Capital Partners acquired the property. Ardent enjoyed a successful ownership period since acquiring the asset in 2014. Century Springs marks OA’s fourth recent office acquisition, increasing their portfolio to more than 2 million square feet.


“We are pleased to have completed the sale of Century Springs to OA Development,” said Matt Shulman, CEO of Ardent. “The transaction reflects our disciplined, asset-by-asset approach to portfolio management and realizing value for our investors. We are proud of our team’s stewardship of the property and the strong tenant relationships it built, and we believe Century Springs is well positioned for its next chapter.”


Josh Videlefsky, Partner at OA Development, stated, “We were attracted to Century Springs for its highly diversified rent roll and premier location. This marks our fourth investment with Buligo in approximately two years and aligns well with our strategy—to acquire well-located office assets relevant post-COVID that we believe are undervalued.”


Century Springs comprises of two mid-rise office buildings and has maintained average occupancy above 90% over the past decade. The asset is poised to benefit from the completion of the neighboring Hillcrest mixed-use development, and walkability to City Springs, Parkside Shops, and other surrounding amenities.


Located in the heart of Sandy Springs within Atlanta’s Central Perimeter submarket, Century Springs offers convenient access to Buckhead, Chastain Park and East Cobb, with regional connectivity via I-285 and Georgia 400. The size of the site also offers long-term optionality for future densification as Sandy Springs continues to grow and evolve.


**About Ardent** **** The Ardent Companies operates as a privately held real estate firm focused on opportunistic and diversified investment strategies. With significant industry experience and a demonstrated track record, Ardent leverages its established relationships and capital flexibility to attain a diverse set of risk-adjusted investments. The firm pursues opportunities with an innovative, disciplined approach, making material investments with its limited partners for maximum alignment. As the firm continues to build upon its infrastructure, portfolio, and footprint, Ardent is committed to creating a positive impact on its employees, investors, and communities. Founded in 2012, Ardent has deployed over $6.8 billion of capital with $2.7 billion in assets currently under management. Ardent’s investment strategies extend across US state lines and country borders, with a current presence in 40 states and three countries. As Ardent expands upon its geographic footprint, the firm continues to grow its employee base with team members based in Atlanta, Charlotte, Miami, Los Angeles, Chicago, and New York City, as well as in London, UK.


**About Newmark** Newmark Group, Inc.
